name: get_store_overview
description: Headline insight, key numbers (share of sizes sold out, estimated $ at risk per week, journey score, changes since the last check), catalog size and data notes.

name: get_restock_priorities
description: Products to restock first, ranked by estimated $ at risk per week (Demand x Gap x Value), with sold-out sizes, demand signals and confidence.

category.description: Product type to filter on, e.g. boots or dresses

name: get_size_gaps
description: Products whose core (middle) sizes are sold out while other sizes are in stock, with the missing sizes.

name: get_promoted_sold_outs
description: Fully sold-out products the store still promotes (home page links, best-seller or featured collections).

name: get_journey_friction
description: Shopper journey scorecard: six stages with scores, each check's status, evidence and suggested fix. Checks blocked by robots.txt are marked not checked.

name: get_recent_changes
description: What changed between the last two checks: sizes that sold out or came back, price changes, products added or removed, with the time window.

name: get_pricing_insights
description: Compare-at price equal to selling price, discount depth, deep discounts, dead stock and the free-shipping threshold against the median price.

name: search_products
description: Search the latest catalog by name, product type, price range, stock, size or discount.

size.description: A size label such as 9 or M; matches products where that size is available

name: get_catalog_health
description: Catalog quality: products with few images, sampled image alt text, short descriptions, missing or inconsistent product types, spreadsheet errors.

name: compare_stores
description: Side-by-side key numbers for the tracked stores, using only checks that ran on every compared store.
